name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid's career began in corporate HR, but her passion for motorsport, ignited by her father's involvement in rally racing, eventually led her to combine her professional expertise with her personal interest. She made the switch to motorsport eight years ago, initially handling recruitment for a smaller team before moving to a more senior role where she helped restructure the entire organization. 

Astrid believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. She is known for her keen eye for talent, her ability to identify potential, and her commitment to creating opportunities for professional development within the team. Her approach is highly collaborative, emphasizing open communication and mutual respect. What sets Astrid apart is her innovative approach to talent management; she's always looking for new ways to attract, retain, and motivate top talent in the competitive world of motorsport. 

Outside of work, Astrid is a keen cyclist and enjoys spending time with her family. She also volunteers at a local animal shelter, demonstrating her caring and compassionate nature.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a subtle wave.
physical.description: Astrid has a warm, friendly face framed by stylish glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small tin of licorice mints and offers them around.
Has a habit of organizing her desk meticulously before starting any task.
Prefers to conduct interviews while walking, believing it puts candidates at ease.
